scenarios.name: Hero Section Display
scenarios.description: Verify the hero section displays a compelling headline, product description, and primary CTAs for user engagement

steps.description: Open the application root URL (/) in a browser
steps.context: User is not authenticated and visits the public homepage

steps.description: Check that the hero section is visible above the fold with headline, description, and CTAs
steps.context: The hero section should be the first content visible without scrolling

steps.description: Confirm the headline clearly communicates URL shortening service value
steps.context: Users should understand the product's purpose within 2 seconds of viewing

test_cases.input: Render Home component and query for hero section elements
test_cases.expected: Hero section contains h1 headline with text about URL shortening

test_cases.input: Check for product description text content
test_cases.expected: Description text mentions URL shortening, analytics, and link management capabilities

test_cases.input: Query for primary CTA buttons in hero section
test_cases.expected: At least two CTA buttons present: 'Sign Up' or 'Get Started' and 'Log In'

test_cases.input: Navigate to / route and visually inspect hero
test_cases.expected: Hero section renders without layout issues, all text is readable

scenarios.name: Navigation to Registration
scenarios.description: Verify users can easily navigate from the homepage to the registration page via prominent CTAs

steps.description: Find the primary 'Sign Up' or 'Get Started' CTA button in the hero section
steps.context: The Sign Up button should be prominently displayed and easily identifiable

steps.description: Click on the Sign Up/Get Started button
steps.context: Button should be clickable and trigger navigation

steps.description: Confirm the user is redirected to the registration page
steps.context: URL should change to /register and registration form should be visible

test_cases.input: Render Home component and click Sign Up button
test_cases.expected: Router navigates to /register route

test_cases.input: Query Sign Up button and verify it has correct href or onClick handler
test_cases.expected: Button links to /register path

test_cases.input: E2E: Navigate to homepage, click Sign Up, verify URL
test_cases.expected: Browser URL changes to /register, registration form is displayed

test_cases.input: Check for additional Sign Up CTAs in features or footer sections
test_cases.expected: All Sign Up buttons navigate to /register consistently

scenarios.name: Navigation to Login

steps.description: Find the 'Log In' button or link in the hero section or navigation

steps.description: Click on the Log In button or link
steps.context: Button should be clickable and trigger navigation

steps.description: Confirm the user is redirected to the login page
steps.context: URL should change to /login and login form should be visible

test_cases.input: Render Home component and click Log In button
test_cases.expected: Router navigates to /login route

test_cases.input: Query Log In button and verify link destination
test_cases.expected: Button or link points to /login path

test_cases.input: E2E: Navigate to homepage, click Log In, verify URL
test_cases.expected: Browser URL changes to /login, login form is displayed

test_cases.input: Check navbar Log In link if present
test_cases.expected: Navbar Log In also navigates to /login
